title: Two weeks into remaking my dragon td game
author: 328amdev
selftext:
Last week I posted the first clip of **Broodguard**, my 3D take on **Lair Defense Shrine and Dungeon**. So here's a progress report on the dev.

# Workflow.

I've set up an **orchestration skill** that decides when the main session should do a job itself and when to hand it to a subagent, which model and effort each job gets, and when to compact.

Long separate jobs go out in parallel like when generating assets and textures it, uses Gemini using Claude-in-Chrome while for testing vfx samples and variant images, it calls Codex with imagegen and for actual game code and model animations, it calls an Opus/Sonnet sub-agent with appropriate effort. Only short reports come back, so the main session keeps its context for reviewing frames instead of filling up with build logs. With these changes, a usual session lasts substantially longer before hitting the 5 hour limit.

# What's new this week.

* **Two new spells**. You drag a line along the screen, and a path shows where spells will land with more to come later on.
* A **main menu** with the fire elder asleep around its eggs, and a world map for picking a level.
* **Four new enemies**. A healer that, well, heals enemy NPCs and a flagbearer that boosts movement speed of enemy units. The other two have resistances against fire and water type damage.
* **The Dragon Archives**, a book with one page describing each dragon (inspired by a certain movie's dragon manual).

>Aiming to have a working demo soon!
